passages.text: Amaranthus polygonoides is a species of flowering plant in the family Amaranthaceae. It is an annual native to Mexico, northern Central America, the Caribbean, the Galápagos, and portions of the south-central and southeastern United States. It goes by the common name of tropical amaranth.

Subdivisions
Three subdivisions are accepted:
Amaranthus polygonoides var. berlandieri {{small|(Moq.) Iamonico}} – south-central United States to Honduras
Amaranthus polygonoides subsp. polygonoides – Caribbean, Florida, South Carolina, and Texas
Amaranthus polygonoides subsp. urceolatus {{small|(Andersson) Iamonico}} – Galápagos
